My plot is small, only a quarter hectare, and I plant maize together with pigeon pea so my family can have some relish too. This year I received a coupon from the government, so I will buy a little NPK and urea — but only enough for my small piece of land. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, but the coupon helped me get a small packet of improved seed. I work the field myself with help from my children; I have no money to hire people, and we do not have a borehole or river close, so we wait for the rains.
